Title: Writ of Acceptance and Anarch and Hackerspace

Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
What happens when a vampire with Writ of Acceptance becomes an Anarch while Hackerspace is in play?

Does the vampire become Anarch for a split second and trigger Hackerspace before Writ makes it Camarilla?

OR

Does the vampire become Anarch, overriding the Writ effect?

OR

Does the Writ prevent the vampire from ever becoming Anarch?

> Writ of Acceptance
> [AH:C2, Tenth:B]
> Cardtype: Equipment

>

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> the1andonlime wrote:
> What happens when a vampire with Writ of Acceptance becomes an Anarch while Hackerspace is in play?
>
> Does the vampire become Anarch for a split second and trigger Hackerspace before Writ makes it Camarilla?
>
Assuming that the vampire is becoming anarch with the cardless action, he changes his underlying sect to Anarch, while remaining Camarilla because of the Writ of Acceptance.

Writ of Acceptance is a temporary effect that "overrides" the underlying sect.

For instance, let's say the vampire was a Sabbat Pander. With the Writ of Acceptance, he's a Camarilla Pander. Since the Camarilla sect is temporary (= as long as he's equipped with the Writ of Acceptance), we keep track of his original underlying sect: Sabbat. That way, the moment he looses the Writ of Acceptance, he reverts back to Sabbat.

Now, he becomes Anarch. He's underlying sect changes to Anarch. The Writ of Acceptance is still "on" so he's still a Camarilla vampire, with Anarch as underlying sect.

> the1andonlime wrote:
> OR
>
> Does the vampire become Anarch, overriding the Writ effect?
>
No.

> the1andonlime wrote:
> Does the Writ prevent the vampire from ever becoming Anarch?
>
No.
